description: This file manages session reset operations, including archiving transcripts, emitting hooks, cleaning up runtime sessions, and resetting session data within a session management system.

methods.name: stripRuntimeModelState
methods.description: Removes runtime-specific properties from a session entry to prepare it for reset or archiving.

methods.name: archiveSessionTranscriptsForSession
methods.description: Archives transcripts for a given session ID and returns their paths.

methods.name: archiveSessionTranscriptsForSessionDetailed
methods.description: Archives detailed transcripts for a session, returning transcript objects.

methods.name: emitGatewaySessionEndPluginHook
methods.description: Triggers the session end hook with relevant session data and transcripts.

methods.name: emitGatewaySessionStartPluginHook
methods.description: Triggers the session start hook with session details.

methods.name: emitSessionUnboundLifecycleEvent
methods.description: Unbinds a session and optionally emits lifecycle hooks for session reset or deletion.

methods.name: ensureSessionRuntimeCleanup
methods.description: Performs cleanup of runtime session resources, including browser tabs and embedded processes.

methods.name: runAcpCleanupStep
methods.description: Runs an asynchronous cleanup operation with a timeout, returning status.

methods.name: closeAcpRuntimeForSession
methods.description: Closes the ACP runtime session, cancelling and closing the session with timeout handling.

methods.name: cleanupSessionBeforeMutation
methods.description: Performs cleanup before session mutation, including runtime cleanup and ACP session closure.

methods.name: emitGatewayBeforeResetPluginHook
methods.description: Emits a hook before resetting a session, providing session messages and context.

methods.name: performGatewaySessionReset
methods.description: Performs a full session reset, archiving transcripts, updating session store, and emitting hooks.
